summary: The article provides a generally reliable overview of HCL Tech's Q2 FY2026 results, with most key financial figures aligning with official reports. However, there are discrepancies in the reported sequential growth for net profit and the revised guidance figures.

claims.claim: The company reported a consolidated revenue of ₹31,942 crores, marking a 5.2% sequential growth and 10.7% year-on-year increase.
claims.note: Official HCLTech Q2 FY2026 highlights confirm these figures.

claims.claim: Net profit for the quarter stood at ₹4,235 crores, an increase of 10.2% sequentially, and flat compared to the same quarter last year.
claims.note: Official HCLTech Q2 FY2026 highlights confirm these figures.

claims.claim: The company's EBIT (Earnings Before Interest and Tax) margin came in at 17.5% (USD) or 17.4% (INR), an increase of 116 basis points sequentially.
claims.note: Official HCLTech Q2 FY2026 highlights confirm these figures.

claims.claim: New deal wins, a critical indicator of future revenue, were reported at USD 2.569 billion in Total Contract Value (TCV), an increase of 41.8% sequentially and 15.8% year-on-year.
claims.note: Official HCLTech Q2 FY2026 highlights confirm these figures.

claims.claim: The management revised its Services Revenue growth (CC) guidance to 4-5% for FY26, while retaining the overall revenue guidance of 3-5% and margin guidance.
claims.note: HCLTech's official Q2 FY26 press release states, 'The company revised its Services Revenue growth (CC) guidance to 4%-5%, while retaining the overall revenue and margin guidance for FY26.'

claims.claim: They also maintained their EBIT margin guidance of 17-18% for FY2026, indicating a strong focus on operational efficiencies and cost optimisation initiatives to protect profitability.
claims.note: HCLTech's official Q2 FY26 press release confirms the EBIT margin guidance of 17-18% for FY26.

article_title: HCL Tech Q2 Results: Navigating Muted Growth and Investor Outlook
